topic_concentration_ip.what: share of each account's 2021-2026 mainspace edits in Israel / Palestine articles (PageAssessments)

topic_concentration_home.what: share of each account's mainspace edits in its own home topic (3 most frequent non-generic WikiProjects of the scoped articles where it made critical-term edits); the like-for-like comparison

direction_consistency.what: accounts with >= 10 critical-term edits: share of those edits in the account's majority direction (0.5 = balanced, 1 = always one way)

cross_article_persistence.what: number of distinct articles where the account's net critical-term change has the sign of its majority direction (scoped articles + outside articles edited by >= 3 accounts of its group)

reinsertion_after_revert.what: share of reverted critical-term edits (scoped articles, reverted by another account) followed within 30 days by the same account moving the same article's critical count the same way again

single_purpose.what: account is single-purpose if >= 50% of its 2021-2026 mainspace edits are in its home topic

timing_vs_events.what: spike weeks of mainspace activity in the 0-14 days after calendar events (lift 1 = no more than the share of weeks those windows cover)

verdicts.topic_concentration: consistent with more concentrated topic interest than the comparison group (higher home-topic share). Concentrated interest is NOT by itself evidence of a vendetta
verdicts.direction_consistency: not distinguishable from the comparison group in how one-directional critical-term edits are
verdicts.cross_article_persistence: consistent with pushing the same direction across more articles than the comparison group
verdicts.reinsertion: the topic group re-inserts LESS after reverts than the comparison group
verdicts.single_purpose: not distinguishable from the comparison group in the share of single-purpose accounts
verdicts.timing: consistent with activity spikes tied more closely to news events than in the comparison group (news-driven editing, not by itself coordination)
